In the same chat, attach:

  1. Your signed application (the PDF you just saved: tap 📎, then Document)
  2. Proof of payment (POP) for the credit check fee
  3. A copy of your ID (both sides of a smart card)
  4. Your latest 3 months' payslips
  5. Your latest 3 months' bank statements

Once these and your POP are in, we run your credit check and your agent will contact you to book a viewing.
